title: Teaching model and local views
note: Commit the teaching model in a claimed lane; build the gitignored views locally to read them. The registered source scanner also runs from mapped main without a work claim and never rewrites model records. Use convert_model.py to repair canonical record formatting; stage cited new files with git add before checking tracked sources. When a view nears the 350-line limit, set `page` to move a large branch or part group to its own page instead of trimming content. CI validates the model and renders pages in memory without comparing local output. The human reading view at views/explore/index.html is one spatial context map. Pan and semantic zoom reveal source, surface, teaching, command and concept nodes in place. Detailed nodes read canonical records and preserve recorded status; related-topic edges are available for a later search overlay after structure review.
